author: Gavin (gmarcialcalleja)
summary: Make GPS clock-fault purge notification idempotent
details: Final review follow-up on PR 67: once a clock fault is latched, unavailable snapshot reads no longer trigger another purge callback. This prevents a synchronous UI refresh from recursively purging. Extend the existing clock-fault regression; contract and device blockers remain.
validation: All 13 portable Swift XCTest cases passed again on Swift 6.0.3 Linux with complete strict concurrency and warnings as errors. Apple SDK adapter remains excluded; no device validation claimed.
